description: ELIGIBILITY - Dribble::vf2 0x143f99eb0 byte table at 0x143f99f60. FallDown (0x11) and Dive (0x0f) currently map to case 3 = refuse outright: while you are on the floor there is NO route back to the ball at all, the animation simply has to finish. Case 2 is the 'ask vf14' handler (the same one Stagger uses). Emulated: Dribble canStart(cur=FallDown) and (cur=Dive) REFUSE -> GATED(vf14). Pair with contact-falldown-cancel-early.json or the gate will sit at the last keyframe anyway.

patches.name: Dribble::vf2 case table: currentKind FallDown -> ask the cancel gate
Dribble::vf2 case table: currentKind Dive -> ask the cancel gate
